messages: Welcome to the execution room for RCKL-4471-01 . ⚙️ What’s locked in Seller: Om Metal Aggregators Buyer: Tata Steel, Jamshedpur Material: MS Scrap HMS 1&2 · 8 MT Rate: ₹34,500/MT · Total ₹2,76,000 Deliver by: 31 May 2026

How I work in this group 👀 I read every message and categorise it — but I do not act on my own. ✋ To create a record (dispatch note, debit note, etc.), reply to the relevant message(s) with @zoai followed by what you want. 🧵 You can stitch multiple messages: reply to one with @zoai and list the others in the same reply. Example: reply to a weighbridge photo with @zoai create dispatch note — vehicle and LR in next 2 messages

Records you can ask me to create 1️⃣ Dispatch note — from weighbridge + vehicle + LR 2️⃣ GRN summary — I post automatically from buyer app 3️⃣ Quality report — I post automatically from buyer app 4️⃣ Debit note — when there is a quality shortfall 5️⃣ Invoice — auto on QC ack, mirrored here 6️⃣ Close-out — once payment is received 📌 Pricing and quantity are locked. For any change, contact Rahul off-channel.
Samajh gaya 🙏 vehicle kal subah lagaa denge, weighbridge ke baad slip yahin daal dunga.
